#app{height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 10px env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}

<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>🧱 Block Blast</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Kéo các khối vào lưới 8×8. Lấp đầy cả hàng hoặc cột để xoá. Xoá đủ số dòng yêu cầu để qua màn, hết chỗ đặt khối là thua.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script>
const GAME={key:'blockblast'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{$('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{$('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=$('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();$('#play').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=false;$('#md').hidden=true;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';$('#lv').textContent='';
 $('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 $('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;$('#md').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=true;$('#play').hidden=false;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='visible';$('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=$('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){$('#mt').textContent=t;$('#mx').textContent=x;const m=$('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});$('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
$('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
$('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

const SHP={
a:['X','XX','X|X','XXX','X|X|X','XX|XX','XX|X.','XX|.X','X.|XX','.X|XX'],
b:['XXXX','X|X|X|X','X.|X.|XX','XX|X.|X.','XXX|X..','XXX|..X','..X|XXX','X..|XXX','XX|XX|XX','XXX|XXX'],
c:['XXXXX','X|X|X|X|X','XXX|XXX|XXX','XXX|X..|X..','XXX|..X|..X','..X|..X|XXX','X..|X..|XXX','XX.|.XX','.XX|XX.','X.|XX|.X','.X|XX|X.','XXX|.X.']};
function parse(s){const rows=s.split('|'),cells=[];rows.forEach((r,y)=>[...r].forEach((ch,x)=>{if(ch=='X')cells.push([y,x])}));return{cells,h:rows.length,w:rows[0].length}}
const PS={};for(const k in SHP)PS[k]=SHP[k].map(parse);
let lv,g,pcs,goal,lines,refr,drag,gh,bw;
function fitAt(p,r,c){return p.cells.every(([y,x])=>!g[(r+y)*8+c+x])}
function fits(p){for(let r=0;r<=8-p.h;r++)for(let c=0;c<=8-p.w;c++)if(fitAt(p,r,c))return true;return false}
function pick(){const ta=Math.max(.15,.8-lv*.008),tc=Math.min(.45,lv*.0045),r=Math.random(),k=r<ta?'a':r<1-tc?'b':'c',a=PS[k];return Object.assign({col:Math.random()*6|0},a[Math.random()*a.length|0])}
function newTray(){for(let t=0;t<80;t++){pcs=[pick(),pick(),pick()];if(pcs.some(fits))return}pcs=[Object.assign({col:0},PS.a[0]),Object.assign({col:1},PS.a[1]),Object.assign({col:2},PS.a[2])]}
function start(l){
 lv=l;goal=Math.round(4+l*.36);lines=0;refr=3;g=Array(64).fill(0);drag=null;
 for(let k=0,n=Math.min(20,Math.floor(l*.2));k<n;k++)g[Math.random()*64|0]=7;
 const b=$('#board');b.className='bb';b.innerHTML='<div></div>'.repeat(64);
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='<div id="tray"></div><button class="b" id="rf"></button>';
 const tr=$('#tray');
 tr.onpointerdown=e=>{const pe=e.target.closest('.pc');if(!pe||over||drag)return;const i=+pe.dataset.i;if(!pcs[i])return;e.preventDefault();pe.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);drag={i,r:-9,c:-9,ok:false};mk(pcs[i]);mvd(e)};
 tr.onpointermove=e=>{if(drag)mvd(e)};
 tr.onpointerup=tr.onpointercancel=e=>{if(!drag)return;mvd(e);const d=drag;endDrag();if(d.ok)place(d.i,d.r,d.c)};
 $('#rf').onclick=()=>{if(over||refr<=0||drag)return;refr--;newTray();say('Đã đổi bộ khối mới.');render();chk()};
 relayout();say('Kéo khối vào lưới. Lấp đầy cả hàng hoặc cột để xoá. Hết chỗ đặt là thua.');
}
function onStop(){endDrag()}
function endDrag(){drag=null;if(gh){gh.remove();gh=null}document.querySelectorAll('#board>div').forEach(d=>d.classList.remove('ok','no'))}
function relayout(){const b=$('#board');if(!b.classList.contains('bb'))return;bw=Math.floor(Math.min(side(135),420));b.style.width=b.style.height=bw+'px';newTrayIfNone();render()}
function newTrayIfNone(){if(!pcs||!pcs.length)newTray()}
function render(){
 const cs=$('#board').children;for(let i=0;i<64;i++)cs[i].className=g[i]?'f'+g[i]:'';
 const z=Math.floor(bw/8*.46);
 $('#tray').innerHTML=pcs.map((p,i)=>p?'<div class="pc" data-i="'+i+'" style="grid-template-columns:repeat('+p.w+','+z+'px);grid-auto-rows:'+z+'px">'+Array.from({length:p.w*p.h},(_,k)=>p.cells.some(q=>q[0]==(k/p.w|0)&&q[1]==k%p.w)?'<div class="f'+(p.col+1)+'"></div>':'<div></div>').join('')+'</div>':'<div class="pc"></div>').join('');
 $('#rf').textContent='🔀 Đổi khối ('+refr+')';
 setInfo('Dòng đã xoá: <b>'+lines+'/'+goal+'</b>');
}
function mk(p){const pitch=($('#board').getBoundingClientRect().width-4)/8;gh=document.createElement('div');gh.id='gh';gh.style.gridTemplateColumns='repeat('+p.w+','+pitch+'px)';gh.style.gridAutoRows=pitch+'px';
 gh.innerHTML=Array.from({length:p.w*p.h},(_,k)=>p.cells.some(q=>q[0]==(k/p.w|0)&&q[1]==k%p.w)?'<div class="f'+(p.col+1)+'"></div>':'<div></div>').join('');document.body.appendChild(gh)}
function mvd(e){
 const p=pcs[drag.i],rc=$('#board').getBoundingClientRect(),pitch=(rc.width-4)/8,lift=e.pointerType=='touch'?pitch*1.6:0;
 const x0=e.clientX-p.w*pitch/2,y0=e.clientY-p.h*pitch/2-lift;gh.style.left=x0+'px';gh.style.top=y0+'px';
 const c=Math.round((x0-rc.left-2)/pitch),r=Math.round((y0-rc.top-2)/pitch);
 const inb=r>=0&&c>=0&&r<=8-p.h&&c<=8-p.w,ok=inb&&fitAt(p,r,c);drag.r=r;drag.c=c;drag.ok=ok;
 const cs=$('#board').children;for(let i=0;i<64;i++)cs[i].classList.remove('ok','no');
 p.cells.forEach(([y,x])=>{const rr=r+y,cc=c+x;if(rr>=0&&cc>=0&&rr<8&&cc<8)cs[rr*8+cc].classList.add(ok?'ok':'no')});
}
function place(i,r,c){
 const p=pcs[i];p.cells.forEach(([y,x])=>g[(r+y)*8+c+x]=p.col+1);pcs[i]=null;
 const rows=[],cols=[];for(let k=0;k<8;k++){let a=true,b=true;for(let j=0;j<8;j++){if(!g[k*8+j])a=false;if(!g[j*8+k])b=false}if(a)rows.push(k);if(b)cols.push(k)}
 const clr=new Set();rows.forEach(k=>{for(let j=0;j<8;j++)clr.add(k*8+j)});cols.forEach(k=>{for(let j=0;j<8;j++)clr.add(j*8+k)});clr.forEach(q=>g[q]=0);
 const n=rows.length+cols.length;lines+=n;
 if(n)say(n>1?'Combo '+n+' dòng!':'Xoá 1 dòng!');else say('');
 if(pcs.every(x=>!x))newTray();
 render();chk();
}
function chk(){
 if(lines>=goal){win('Bạn đã xoá '+lines+' dòng!');return}
 if(!pcs.some(p=>p&&fits(p)))fail('Hết chỗ để đặt khối. Bạn đã xoá '+lines+'/'+goal+' dòng.');
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
